source.title: A comparative survey of selected results and open problems concerning topological groups, fields and vector spaces

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 1307905. Direct shell fetching of the zbMATH page returned a Cloudflare challenge rather than readable source text.

zbMATH API metadata identified the exact work as Dmitri Shakhmatov, "A comparative survey of selected results and open problems concerning topological groups, fields and vector spaces," Topology and its Applications 91(1), pages 51-63, 1999, DOI 10.1016/S0166-8641(97)00242-3. Crossref confirmed the DOI, title, journal, pages, and ScienceDirect/Elsevier links. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported the work as closed access with no best OA location and no repository full text.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged for zbMATH and ScienceDirect browser-facing pages, plus metadata_only/paywalled_or_restricted after resolver checks. Bounded exact-work recovery tried the DOI landing page, Elsevier linkinghub, ScienceDirect article/PDF endpoints, Crossref TDM links, OpenAlex OA metadata, and exact-title searches. Inspected candidates were ScienceDirect abstract/metadata, author and institutional publication listings, citation pages, and papers that merely cite the target work. No candidate exposed a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML body containing the technical problem statements.
